title: 2025 REEFSCAPE robot
role: Drive from the starting area to the coral station, align the receiver and hold position through the first feed. Explore the chassis and see where the prebuild simulation evidence stops.
revision: R3 · fixed-height receiver · stowed, red alliance

cad.title: Full swerve robot · stowed, red alliance
cad.scope: Rotate the complete R3 prebuild layout to find the four swerve corners, receiver, electronics and two red bumper covers. The public model has 959 solids in 22 appearance groups. Project-drawn envelopes identify commercial components. The student Fusion handoff documents which supplier models are available locally.

sources.label: Reviewed inspection mass and wire-length cases
sources.revision: Matched four-module drawing and rear electronics repair

sources.label: R3 model, colors and part representations

results.claim: Both 65 kg approaches docked before the first feed
results.conditions: The mirrored approaches reached the docking gate at 20.285 s and 20.330 s. The first feed was scheduled for 21.100 s.
results.limit: Four adverse cases missed the docking gate. The film follows one nominal approach.

results.claim: The receiver held the first piece through 27.03 s
results.conditions: Both simulated approach signs reached the in-band receiver state at 22.912 s. Two solver step sizes reproduced it.
results.limit: The simulation ends at the station. Loaded departure, delivery and a scored piece still need evidence.

results.claim: The selected drawing leaves 170 g under the inspection limit
results.conditions: The matched 944-item bill puts the upper estimate at 51.993 kg, against a 52.163 kg limit. The calculation uses the machined shelf, the repaired rear electronics and the specified cable cuts.
results.limit: Uniform 1 m supply cuts put the same estimate 4.9 g over. The opening trials used separate 65 kg and 72 kg operating hypotheses. Final inspection weight has not been measured.

build.configuration: Four swerve modules on a 564 mm wheelbase and 554 mm track. Each wheel steers and rolls independently. The handoff identifies the supplier model revision and links the editable mounting saddle.
The shelf and guide arms sit above the four independently steered wheels. The public view shows the receiver stowed and both red bumper covers installed.
Both red covers wrap around the perimeter. Their two-piece construction preserves access to the corner modules. The color registry identifies the cover shade as #D71920.

media.caption: Nominal approach at real time. The field view shows the path to the station. The four-wheel diagram follows simulated steering and rolling speeds at 10 frames per second.
media.description: A field replay beside four labeled wheel directions, with the match clock and station event visible.
